M0-02 (2026-11-24): Crew itself installs from source (git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew; python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/pip install -e .), the desktop .deb, or `kiro-cli crew --yes`; never `pip install kirocrew` (the PyPI package is an empty placeholder).
